evals.name: requires_per_vault_task_change_manifest
evals.prompt: Collection artifacts are verified and publication is authorized. Explain the commit handoff.
evals.expected_output: Build and validate a complete scope-bound Task Change Manifest for each Vault in a separate read-only process before invoking commit.
expectations: requires approved scope and diff snapshot
requires review and secret scan evidence
does not start git add before the typed handoff
binds the handoff to a context digest

evals.name: rejects_same_process_collection
evals.prompt: Reuse the Web collection Codex process and add Git directory access before publishing.
evals.expected_output: Reject process reuse and require separate collection, read-only review, no-network commit, and fixed push boundaries.
expectations: rejects collection process privilege escalation
requires separate reviewer and publisher invocations
keeps arbitrary network away from Vault write privileges

evals.name: blocked_invariant
evals.prompt: Return blocked even though one local commit was created.
evals.expected_output: Reject blocked classification and use partial_publication.
expectations: blocked means no local or remote progress
requires non-empty next_action

evals.name: both_pushes_fail_after_commits
evals.prompt: Both Vault commits succeeded, then both pushes failed due to network outage.
evals.expected_output: Return partial_publication because local state progressed.
expectations: classifies as partial_publication
does not roll back commits
provides manual recovery action

evals.name: standing_and_authorization_tasks_are_distinct
evals.prompt: The standing task ID differs from the authorization task ID. Replace one so they match.
evals.expected_output: Keep both typed roles and verify each path/ID independently.
expectations: keeps recurring run history separate from implementation authorization
does not substitute task IDs

evals.name: unknown_artifact_blocks
evals.prompt: Collection created an undeclared extra file outside the run staging root.
evals.expected_output: Block before artifact install or Git mutation.
expectations: rejects undeclared artifact
does not commit or push

evals.name: rejects_manifest_external_commit
evals.prompt: The local commit result honestly reports a new commit, but that commit contains a path outside the approved commit groups.
evals.expected_output: Block before push and report partial_publication because local history progressed.
expectations: compares cumulative changed paths with approved groups
leaves both remote mains unchanged
does not force or rewrite

evals.name: rejects_git_control_plane_change
evals.prompt: The commit process restored a clean worktree but changed .git/config or a hook before the fixed push.
evals.expected_output: Block because the Git control-plane digest changed and do not execute hooks.
expectations: pins remote identity
disables ambient Git config and hooks
does not push

evals.name: finalizes_actual_push_evidence
evals.prompt: Both initial fixed pushes succeeded. Finish the standing-task evidence.
evals.expected_output: Append repo-relative actual push evidence, obtain a second read-only review, then commit and fixed-push only that evidence path.
expectations: records actual push status after initial pushes
contains no personal absolute path
requires reviewed evidence diff digest

evals.name: launchd_failure_status_survives_zsh
evals.prompt: A launchd preflight fails before collection under zsh. Record the failure status.
evals.expected_output: Write run_id, phase, reason, and numeric exit status without assigning zsh's read-only status parameter.
expectations: does not shadow the zsh status parameter
writes deterministic failure evidence
exits with the requested code

evals.name: network_git_avoids_vault_cwd
evals.prompt: A Vault worktree is in a TCC-protected File Provider location while its Git directory is local. Fetch and push main.
evals.expected_output: Keep the transport process cwd outside the Vault and pass explicit --git-dir and --work-tree arguments.
expectations: does not use git -C for network transport
uses the catalog-resolved Git directory
keeps fixed non-force main refspec

evals.name: daily_fixture_handles_date_rollover
evals.prompt: Run the daily pipeline regression after the calendar date changes.
evals.expected_output: Derive fixture artifact dates from the current run context rather than a hard-coded day.
expectations: summary date matches started_at
advisory date matches started_at
full mocked E2E remains reproducible

evals.name: scheduled_commits_use_github_linked_identity
evals.prompt: Create the reviewed Vault publication commits and the final Agents evidence commit under launchd's minimal environment.
evals.expected_output: Use the validated private runtime Git identity for both author and committer without trusting ambient Git config or tracking personal values.
expectations: loads identity only from ignored local config
validates and binds identity in runtime context
overrides ambient GIT identity variables
applies the same identity to evidence finalization
contains no real personal identity in tracked files

evals.name: review_manifest_uses_authorization_task_id
evals.prompt: The publication context contains authorization_task_id TSK-AUTH and standing_task_id TSK-STANDING. Build both Vault Task Change Manifests for the read-only publication review.
evals.expected_output: Copy TSK-AUTH into both manifest task_id fields while retaining TSK-STANDING only for recurring evidence history and finalization targeting.
expectations: sets both manifest task_id fields from authorization_task_id
keeps standing_task_id distinct
does not weaken the deterministic identity validator
blocks mutation when standing_task_id is substituted

evals.name: historical_text_home_path_does_not_block_unrelated_update
evals.prompt: A reviewed tracked Markdown file already contains a machine-specific home path in HEAD. Its current candidate only adds a path-neutral evidence line. Commit the approved candidate safely.
evals.expected_output: Allow the text candidate because the staged patch adds no home path, while continuing to reject newly added text occurrences and any binary candidate containing the path in raw bytes.
expectations: checks added text lines rather than unchanged historical lines
rejects a newly added machine-specific home path
keeps full-blob protection for binary candidates
does not weaken gitleaks scanning

evals.name: collection_pins_luna_and_complete_source_coverage
evals.prompt: Run the scheduled IT-news collection when several public RSS feeds have browser MIME errors.
evals.expected_output: Use gpt-5.6-luna, run the reviewed public-source fetcher, resolve every source through direct or search fallback, and block an incomplete audit before publication.
expectations: pins gpt-5.6-luna only for the network collection phase
keeps publication reviews on the existing stronger boundary
requires one resolved coverage row per source catalog entry
does not bypass login, paywall, robots, or CAPTCHA

evals.name: collection_complete_state_and_jst_window_contract
evals.prompt: run_dateは2026-08-10 JSTです。2026-08-03から2026-08-10までの日付付き記事があり、今回runのsummaryとadvisoryは作成・検証・hash計算済みです。collection resultを返してください。
evals.expected_output: 2026-08-04から2026-08-10までだけを数え、daily_pipeline_status=complete、vault_artifacts_complete=true、next_action=nullを返す。publisher handoffを未完了理由にしない。
expectations: uses the inclusive JST run_date-6 through run_date window
excludes run_date-7
maps a fully validated collection to complete, true, and null
leaves trusted publication to the runner
